deepseek-v4.1-flash:IST-DAS-1.75bpw.about: the smallest official version: 121 GB of model + 111 GB n-gram table + 8 GB drafter (239 GB of disk, 18 GB less than 2.00). Runs where 2.00 is tight (a 12 GB card and 32-40 GB of RAM). Smallest: fine for code and agent work, noticeably weaker on plain prose; pick 2.00 if it fits
deepseek-v4.1-flash:IST-DAS-1.75bpw.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash IST-DAS-1.75bpw

deepseek-v4.1-flash:IST-DAS-2.00bpw.about: the smaller official version: 138 GB of model + 111 GB n-gram table + 8 GB drafter (257 GB of disk). Runs on a PC with a 12 GB card and 40-64 GB of RAM at about 5-7 tokens a second; quality about 15.5% above the original model's perplexity (code and agent work 5-9%)
deepseek-v4.1-flash:IST-DAS-2.00bpw.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash IST-DAS-2.00bpw

deepseek-v4.1-flash:IST-DAS-2.25bpw.about: the better official version: 155 GB of model + 111 GB n-gram table + 8 GB drafter (274 GB of disk, 17 GB more than 2.00). About the same speed; quality about 7.3% above the original model's perplexity (code and agent work 2-3%)
deepseek-v4.1-flash:IST-DAS-2.25bpw.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash IST-DAS-2.25bpw

deepseek-v4.1-flash:ISTA-DAS-Coder.about: ISTA-DAS's coding version of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: 192 of the model's 384 experts in every layer are kept, the rest removed, with the 2.00 version's file layout and tensor types: 72 GB of model + 111 GB n-gram table + 8 GB drafter (about 197 GB of disk). Run on a Mac (M5 Max) and a Ryzen AI Max at about 20 tokens a second. Against the original model (our test, 4,995 positions): perplexity +48%, KL 0.40 (2.00 bpw: +16%, 0.17; 2.25 bpw: +8%, 0.11)
deepseek-v4.1-flash:ISTA-DAS-Coder.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash ISTA-DAS-Coder

deepseek-v4.1-flash:UD-IQ1_M.about: Unsloth's next dynamic version: 140 GB of model (experts in IQ1_S / IQ2_XXS / IQ2_XS / IQ2_S, attention in Q6_K) + the 111 GB n-gram table + 8 GB drafter. Same size class as ISTA-DAS 2.00 bpw. Part of its experts are 1-bit: expect somewhat weaker answers than the 2.25 version on long, detailed or careful work (short answers, code and tool calls looked fine in our check; its quality is not measured against the original yet)
deepseek-v4.1-flash:UD-IQ1_M.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash UD-IQ1_M

deepseek-v4.1-flash:UD-IQ1_S.about: Unsloth's smallest dynamic version: 122 GB of model (experts in IQ1_S / IQ2_XXS, attention in Q6_K) + the 111 GB n-gram table + 8 GB drafter. Same size class as ISTA-DAS 1.75 bpw. A 1-bit version: expect weaker answers than the 2.00 and 2.25 versions on long, detailed or careful work (short answers, code and tool calls looked fine in our check; its quality is not measured against the original yet). Pick 2.00 or 2.25 if they fit
deepseek-v4.1-flash:UD-IQ1_S.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash UD-IQ1_S

deepseek-v4.1-flash:UD-Q8_K_XL.about: Unsloth Dynamic 8-bit: the experts in MXFP4 as DeepSeek made them, the rest in BF16 (the checkpoint's own precision); 508 GB, for machines with hundreds of GB of RAM or several cards
